cases.claim: “LOSING MY GROOVE. THANKS, ASTHMA” (meme) | “Asthma. Does it have you missing out on what you love, with who you love? Get back to better breathing with FASENRA. . . ”
cases.context: Woman bored at home → salsa dancing with friends, selfie with 'likes'. AQLQ(S)+12 total responder rate improved vs placebo, but studies not designed to measure individual items incl. social/emotional functioning.
cases.rationale: Implies improved social/emotional functioning; greater benefit than demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: before/after social-life transformation (memes, 'likes', 'missing out') when only a total QoL score was studied; item-level social/emotional claims unsupported.

cases.cat: Distracting presentation of material efficacy qualifier (SUPER)
cases.claim: [Visual] fast-paced salsa dancing and music during SUPER with indication and dosing/administration (frames 3–7)
cases.rationale: Competing presentations distract from material information about the drug.
cases.check: Storyboard check: competing audio/visual elements during indication/dosing SUPERs.

cases.cat: Major statement not in dual modality / incomplete major statement (TV)
cases.claim: [Omission/Format] hypersensitivity information included only in the SUPERs; audio omits telling HCP or getting emergency help for allergic reaction symptoms (per Patient Package Insert); SUPERs and audio not verbatim/key-term matched
cases.rationale: Fails to present major statement in dual modality and omits material information from audio.
cases.check: Rule: align audio transcript with SUPER text; flag text-only risk items and missing PPI/MG action statements.
